title: Perturbational complexity tracks the level of consciousness

statements.text: Because consciousness needs activity that is both integrated across cortex and differentiated, the complexity of the cortical response to a magnetic pulse measures the level of consciousness independent of sensory input and behavior.

standing.reason: Candidate for supported: TMS with high-density EEG found a local, short response in NREM sleep against a spreading one in wakefulness, and the perturbational complexity index separated wakefulness, sleep, three anesthetics and post-coma patients individually. The finding is the candidate, not its IIT reading.

sources.quote: Theoretical considerations suggest that consciousness depends on the brain's ability to support complex activity patterns that are, at once, distributed among interacting cortical areas (integrated) and differentiated in space and time (information-rich).
